description: April 28 birthday meaning: Taurus decan 1, birthday number 1, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an April 28 birthday falls in Taurus, in the first decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 1. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Taurus is fixed and earth.

sections.heading: The April 28 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: April 28 reduces to 1, adding an independent streak to steady Taurus. The Sun sits roughly seven degrees into the fixed earth sign, still in its Venus-ruled first decan. Interpreters often describe a self-reliant, quietly stubborn individual who prefers to build on their own terms and resists being hurried by anyone.

Astronomically, April 28 puts the Sun near 7° Taurus in most years, inside the first ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Venus. With Venus as both ruler and sub-ruler, the first decan of Taurus is traditionally seen as the sign at its most sensuous and steady. Birthdays from about April 20 to April 30 land here. The emphasis is on comfort that has been earned: texture, taste, music and the slow pleasure of things done well. This doubled Venus tone is often linked with loyalty and a calm, grounding presence that friends lean on. It can also make change feel like an imposition rather than an invitation. Those born in this decan tend to flourish when they treat flexibility as another form of care, not a threat to it.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for April 28
paragraphs: A birthday on the 28th reduces as 2 + 8 = 10, then 1 + 0 = 1. The birthday number is 1, but reached by a route that runs through partnership (2) and authority (8). Numerologists often read the 28th as a more cooperative kind of leader than the 1st: independent and ambitious, yet aware that big plans need allies. Those born on this day are frequently described as determined, enterprising and persuasive. As a supporting number, the 28 tends to show in a talent for starting things with others already on board, rather than recruiting help after the fact.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: an April 28 birthday gives Life Path 6 for 1990, 7 for 2000, 8 for 2010 and 9 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous April 28 birthdays
paragraphs: April birthdays arrive in full northern spring, with lengthening days and fast growth; in the southern hemisphere the month belongs to mid-autumn and harvest. Aries carries most of April, handing over to Taurus around April 19 or 20. As month 4, April brings numerology's number of structure, steadiness and hard work, a grounding counterweight to the quick fire of the month's early birthdays. April 28 is the 118th day of the year (119th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Gemini, is usually complete within 23 days, by May 21.

By April 28 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with an April 28 birthday are Saddam Hussein (1937), James Monroe (1758) and Penélope Cruz (1974).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is April 28?
faq.answer: April 28 is Taurus in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Taurus, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on April 28?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On April 28 the Life Path is 3 in 1960, 4 in 1970, 5 in 1980, 6 in 1990, 7 in 2000, 8 in 2010 and 9 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 1 for everyone born on the 28th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on April 28?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by April 28, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on April 28?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on April 28 include Saddam Hussein (1937), James Monroe (1758) and Penélope Cruz (1974). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
